summary: Bandai Namco's sci-fi hunting action-RPG series, including the PSP originals, enhanced remakes, numbered sequels, Japanese photo spin-offs, and mobile/live-service branches.

entries.title: God Eater
entries.definitive_edition: God Eater Resurrection for the complete modern route; original PSP for first-version documentation

emulation.notes: Use high internal resolution and texture filtering only if it does not distort UI/text.

primary.version: Original Japanese PSP release via PPSSPP
primary.why: The original God Eater is a PSP release; for the exact first version, PPSSPP provides the best capture and upscaling path, while Resurrection is the later remake branch.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Japanese PSP original through PPSSPP with high internal resolution if documenting the first release. For a modern full-story run, use God Eater Resurrection separately.

all_releases.reason: primary: only release of the unexpanded original game; PPSSPP gives the best capture path.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: This is the historical original; Gods Eater Burst and God Eater Resurrection add story/gameplay content and are better full-play options.

entries.remaster_caveats: The later Resurrection release is a remake of Burst/the original, not the untouched 2010 PSP build.

entries.title: Gods Eater Burst
entries.definitive_edition: God Eater Resurrection for modern play; Gods Eater Burst for the PSP-era expanded version

emulation.notes: Use high internal resolution; check mission UI readability after scaling.

primary.why: Gods Eater Burst is the expanded PSP version of God Eater with additional story and gameplay features; PPSSPP is the best route for the PSP version.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PSP release in PPSSPP with high internal resolution. Use Resurrection instead when prioritizing modern visuals and the added Resurrection story arc.

all_releases.reason: primary: only release of the Burst PSP version; later Resurrection is a separate remake/remaster branch.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Burst is more complete than the original PSP game, but Resurrection adds further systems and story on newer platforms.

entries.remaster_caveats: Resurrection changes/expands Burst and should be tracked separately from the PSP original.

entries.title: God Eater Resurrection

emulation.notes: Use PC release for main capture.

primary.why: Resurrection is the modern remake/remaster path for the first God Eater story, and the PC release offers the highest capture fidelity among the documented platforms.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam release on PC, either standalone where available or bundled with God Eater 2: Rage Burst purchases depending on storefront availability.

all_releases.reason: skip: portable route, but lower capture fidelity than PC.
skip: strong console route, but PC is more flexible for capture.
primary: highest-fidelity and most capture-friendly route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Resurrection is the complete modern route for the first game's story branch.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a remake/remaster of Burst/the original with added systems and story; use PSP releases for original-version documentation.

primary.why: The original God Eater 2 shipped on PSP and Vita; the Vita version is the highest-fidelity original-release route before the later Rage Burst expansion.
primary.how_to_play: Play on original PlayStation Vita hardware for the original version, or use the separate Rage Burst entry on PC when prioritizing complete modern content.

primary: best version of the unexpanded original God Eater 2 release.
